description: Ordinary actor combat and explicit shot context; full actor dispatcher and playable game remain unfinished.

decisions.reference: Thirteen unmodified original C actions with original melee and facing helpers; all 70 output fields and ordered event/RNG traces match.
scope: Pistol, shotgun and chaingun sound/facing/aim order and pellet RNG
Chaingun and spider refire early RNG, target health and visibility
Imp, demon, cacodemon, bruiser and revenant melee order
Missing targets, shadow spread, angles, distance and random starts
Actual effects, damage, missile half-steps, owner handles and refire
Enemy and both player shot paths activate shootable doors
Nested trace overwrite retains captured outer impact
Callback failure stops subsequent impact and releases captured line memory

remaining: Pain/death/fall and remaining special actor actions
Native host input/render pacing and UI/audio
